full_text: Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE OPINION NO. 76 S. June 01, 2010 MAYOR ROGER DIZON Sibutao, Zamboanga del Norte Dear Mayor Dizon: 2010 This pertains to your letter requesting this Department's legal opinion regarding Municipal Ordinance No. 07-2009 of the Sangguniang Bayan re: "Grant of Exemplary Public Service Awards to Municipal Election Officials who have for served three (3) consecutive terms in the same or any other elective positions in the local government unit concerned in a form of cash equivalent to six (6) months basic salary exclusive of other remunerations such as bonuses, representation and transportation allowances and any other emoluments which are normally earned from the Office they hold." In -this regard, please be informed that we have already answered a similar query in DILG Opinion No. 6 s. 2008, where we opined that such grant is tenable citing Section 393 (a) of the Local Government Code of 1991 (RA 7160) as legal basis therefore. Moreover, before any money shall be paid out of the local treasury or any disbursement is made therefrom, a law or an ordinance authorizing such an appropriation should be enacted first. Attached herewith is the copy of the DILG Opinion No. 6 s. 2008 for your ready reference. Very truly yours, By Authority of the Secretary: cc. : A Dir. Paisal Abutazil, CESO 111 DILG Regional Office No. IX FS Pajares Avenue, San Francisco Pagadian City Y. JES Dir ctor II QUE IV Legal: 94/ Merle
